annotations.title: Fetch full details for a OneHome listing

description: Fetch full details for a single OneHome listing by id or portal URL. Returns address, list / close / previous price, $/sqft, beds/baths/sqft, lot size (raw `lot_size` {area, units} plus the derived `lot_size_acres` — null, never 0, for condos / lotless listings), year built, lat/lng, status, HOA fee, annual tax, virtual-tour URL, the primary photo, and an `extracted_features` block (lake_front, hot_tub, basement, furnished, dock, community) keyword-parsed from the description. The raw `description` (PublicRemarks) is omitted by default — pass `include_description: true` to keep it; in most cases the extracted features cover what callers need. OneHome scopes every listing to a group/market — `group_id` defaults to the magic-link session context; pass it explicitly only if you need to query a different group.

include_description.description: Include the raw `description` (PublicRemarks) in the response. Defaults to `false` — `extracted_features` is always populated and usually sufficient.

name: onehome_get_property
title: Fetch full details for a OneHome listing
